ةﻮﻄﺨﺑ ةﻮﻄﺧ ..ﻚﺘﯾاﺮﻗ ﻲﻓPARAGRAPHS · UNIT 1 Holidays in the Past vs Holidays Now
In the past, people used to spend their holidays in the company of their families and
relatives since family life used to be a priority. There used to be so many activities to do
at home, like helping parents in keeping the house tidy or enjoying cooking meals.
Besides, so many students helped their parents on the farm in collecting the
agricultural products or harvesting. In addition, reading was an excellent hobby for
many students or adults, which used to improve their language skills, so we used to
find hundreds of people who went to the public libraries or bought books. Moreover,
the beach was an opportunity for many people who used to meet and have fun, without
forgetting going to the cinema, where people enjoyed watching movies and dating
each other.
However, nowadays people spend their holidays with friends, and whenever they go to
the beach, they practise various activities like water skiing, sunbathing and canoeing.
Furthermore, the internet is dominating a great part of people's holidays since they
stay chatting and e-mailing the whole day or surfing from one web page to another.
Added to that, there are many competitions between travel agencies, which have
made travelling an easy and cheap activity, and we can find many interesting and
affordable offers. They can also learn foreign languages in different private and public
institutions. Besides, because our society is becoming more and more consumeristic,
shopping is emerging as a new entertaining activity.
